basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old collector and trader from California, with a keen interest in virtual economies and digital collectibles. I spend a lot of my time managing trades and sales on Royale High Trading, and when I'm not trading, I'm exploring interesting topics on subreddits like hoarderhouses and katana. My work as a freelance graphic designer allows me the flexibility to be online during odd hours, mostly late evenings to early mornings. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies and interact with a diverse online community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital design and have been an avid gamer and trader for the past five years. My expertise in trading comes from countless hours spent researching market trends and participating in trading forums. I also have a degree in Graphic Design, which honed my skills in digital aesthetics and marketing.
